info.title: ForgeBase API
info.description: REST API over ForgeBase's SQL, collection and document engine. Errors are `{"error":{"code","message","request_id","details?"}}`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <access token | API key | personal access token>`, `X-API-Key`, or the `fb_session` cookie (+ `X-CSRF-Token` on writes); see `/api/auth/*` and ADR-0004. Requests without credentials are anonymous and the authorizer decides; the `/api/v1` data API is versioned additively (ADR-0001 §6).

collection.description: Collection to analyze; every collection when absent.

commands.description: Commands run in order with no other command in between.

Bin.description:
A binary-safe value: a string, or `{"base64": "..."}` for bytes that are
not UTF-8.

max.description: At most this many jobs (default 1, at most 50).

worker_id.description: The claiming worker (any id of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`, at most 128 characters).

jobs.description: Up to the requested number; empty when nothing is due.

ClaimedJob.description: A claimed job with the lease that fences it.

lease_id.description: Secret token: `heartbeat`, `complete` and `fail` must present it.

versioned.description: Keep every version of every record.

json_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of a record of this collection.

ids.description: 1 to 1000 ids; unknown ids are ignored.

Edge.description: A typed edge between two nodes.

directed.description: `false` for an undirected relationship (walked both ways).

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 time of the last change.

EdgeChange.description: Body of `PATCH /edges/{id}`: only properties can change.

properties.description: JSON merge patch (RFC 7396; `null` removes a key).

next_after.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; absent on the last page.

details.description:
Structured context, e.g. per-field validation errors
(`{"fields": {"name": {"code": "required", "message": "..."}}}`).
Additive and optional (ADR-0001 §6).

request_id.description: Id of the request (also in the `x-request-id` response header).

command.description: Command name followed by arguments, e.g. `["INCRBY", "hits", "5"]`.

retryable.description: `false` sends the job straight to the dead-letter queue (default `true`).

FieldSpec.description: Definition of a vector field, as sent when creating it.

expansion_add.description: HNSW candidate list size while inserting (default 128).

expansion_search.description:
HNSW candidate list size while searching (default 128). Higher means
better recall and slower searches.

oneOf.description: Element type of the ANN index (default `f32`).

FilterMode.description: When a metadata filter is applied relative to the vector search.

cancel_requested.description: The job was cancelled: stop and call `fail`.

text_score.description: BM25 relevance in the keyword ranking (higher is better).

HybridRequest.description:
A hybrid search: keyword (FTS5, BM25) and vector rankings fused with
Reciprocal Rank Fusion: `score = Σ weight / (rrf_k + rank)`.

candidates.description:
Candidates taken from each ranking before fusion (default
`max(5 k, 50)`, at most 1000).

field.description: Vector field; may be omitted when the collection has exactly one.

filter.description: Metadata filter, applied to both rankings.

filter_mode.description: When the filter is applied on the vector side.

params.description: Values for `{:name}` parameters of the filter.

text.description:
Keyword query; every word is matched literally (optional:
vector-only without it).

oneOf.description: How the vector side was answered (absent without a query vector).

HybridWeights.description: Weights of the two rankings in hybrid search.

by.description: Amount to add (default 1; negative to decrement).

IndexState.description: Life cycle of a derived index.

IndexStatus.description: State and metrics of one field's ANN index.

ann_searches.description: Searches answered by the ANN index since start.

canonical_vectors.description: Canonical vectors stored for the field.

capacity.description: Reserved slots of the serving index.

dirty.description: The index has changes not yet written to its file.

exact_searches.description: Searches answered by brute force since start.

expansion_search.description: HNSW candidate list size while searching.

last_saved.description: When the file was last written.

mean_search_ms.description: Mean search latency since start, in milliseconds.

memory_bytes.description: Memory used by the serving index.

reason.description: Why the index is not ready, or why the running rebuild started.

serialized_bytes.description: Size of the index file when saved.

serving.description: `ann` when searches use an index, `exact` when they scan.

Job.description: A job. The lease token is never part of it (see [`ClaimedJob`]).

attempts.description: Claims so far (a lost lease counts).

backoff_base_ms.description: First retry delay in milliseconds; doubles per attempt up to `backoff_max_ms`.

backoff_max_ms.description: Cap of the retry delay in milliseconds.

cancel_requested.description: Cancellation was requested while running; workers should stop and `fail`.

finished_at.description: When it reached a terminal state (RFC 3339).

max_attempts.description: Attempts before the job is dead-lettered.

result.description: Handler output of a succeeded job.

run_at.description: Earliest start (RFC 3339); moves forward while waiting to retry.

visibility_timeout_ms.description: Time in milliseconds a worker may hold the job without a heartbeat.

visibility_until.description: While running: when the lease expires without a heartbeat (RFC 3339).

worker_id.description: Worker that holds (or held last) the job.

JobEvent.description: One entry of a job's history.

JobPage.description: A page of jobs, newest first.

totals.description: Counts over all queues by state.

size.description: Length: bytes, fields, items, members or entries.

ttl_ms.description: Milliseconds until expiry; absent when the key does not expire.

value.description: The value: string; `{field: value}`; `[items]`; `[{member, score}]`; `[{id, fields}]`.

evicted_keys.description: Keys removed to stay within the memory budget.

expired_keys.description: Keys removed because their TTL passed.

keys.description: Keys of all tenants (expired keys not yet swept included).

persistent.description: Whether changes are written to SQLite.

unsaved_keys.description: Keys changed in memory and not yet written to SQLite.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

MembersBody.description: Body of set add/remove and sorted-set remove.

Metric.description: Distance function of a vector field.

NamespaceInfo.description: One namespace of the caller's tenant.

direction.description:
`out` when the queried node is the edge's source, `in` when it is the
target (also for undirected edges).

node.description: The node at the other end.

next_after.description: Pass as `offset` for the next page; absent on the last page.

exact_threshold.description:
Searches over at most this many candidate vectors are exact (brute
force) instead of approximate. Default from the server configuration.

fields.description: Vector fields (at most 16; more can be added later).

source.description: Source node id; the node must exist.

target.description: Target node id; the node must exist.

backoff_base_ms.description: First retry delay in ms (default 1000); doubles per attempt.

backoff_max_ms.description: Cap of the retry delay in ms (default 1 hour).

delay_ms.description: Earliest start as a delay from now in milliseconds.

idempotency_key.description: Enqueueing the same key twice in a queue returns the first job.

run_at.description: Earliest start, RFC 3339. Mutually exclusive with `delay_ms`.

visibility_timeout_ms.description: Time in ms a worker may hold the job without a heartbeat (default 60000).

id.description: Id; generated when absent. 1 to 128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : @ -`.

backoff_max_ms.description: Cap of the retry delay in ms.

cron.description: Cron expression (UTC; 5 fields, or 6 with leading seconds).

id.description: Id to use; generated when absent.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 time of the last change.

NodeChange.description: Body of `PUT` (replace) and `PATCH` (merge) on a node.

properties.description:
`PUT`: replaces the properties. `PATCH`: JSON merge patch (RFC 7396;
`null` removes a key).

deleted_edges.description: Edges that touched the node and were deleted with it.

NodeFilter.description: Node filter: label and property equality (all must match).

properties.description:
Property equality, e.g. `{"country": "IN"}`. Values are strings, numbers
or booleans; keys are `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`. At most 8.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; absent on the last page.

edge_types.description: Edge types to follow; empty or absent = all.

PathResult.description: Result of a shortest-path search (unweighted: fewest hops).

length.description: Number of edges on the path.

values.description: Values, pushed one after the other.

Quantization.description:
Element type of the ANN index. Canonical vectors are always stored as
float32; a smaller type makes the derived index smaller and faster at some
cost in precision.

queued.description: Waiting (including delayed and waiting to retry).

field.description: Only this field (default: every field of the collection).

RecallReport.description: Result of a recall check: ANN results compared with exact results.

ann_ms.description: Total time of the ANN searches.

exact_ms.description: Total time of the exact searches.

recall.description: Mean of |ANN ∩ exact| / k, from 0 to 1.

samples.description: Queries run (stored vectors used as queries).

field.description: Vector field; may be omitted when the collection has exactly one.

cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; `"0"` when done.

backoff_max_ms.description: Cap of the retry delay in ms.

cron.description: Cron expression (UTC; 5 fields, or 6 with leading seconds).

visibility_timeout_ms.description: Visibility timeout of the jobs in ms.

score.description: Score (a finite number, or the strings are not accepted: use `exec` for infinities).

distance.description: Distance in the field's metric (lower is closer).

score.description:
Similarity (higher is closer): cosine similarity, dot product, or
`1 / (1 + euclidean distance)`.

exact.description: Brute force instead of the ANN index (ground truth, small sets).

field.description: Vector field; may be omitted when the collection has exactly one.

filter.description:
Metadata filter in the filter language, e.g.
`category = 'news' && year >= 2020`.

params.description: Values for `{:name}` parameters of the filter.

candidates.description: Items matching the filter, when the filter was evaluated first.

nx.description: Only set when the key does not exist.

xx.description: Only set when the key exists.

sql.description: SQL text; parameter values are never recorded.

statements.description: 1 to 1000 statements, run in one all-or-nothing transaction.

fields.description: Field names and values (sent in name order).

maxlen.description: Keep at most this many entries.

TextOperator.description: How the words of a keyword query combine.

threshold_ms.description: Statements slower than this are logged; `0` logs every statement.

edge_types.description: Edge types to follow; empty or absent = all (at most 20).

oneOf.description: Filter applied to the returned nodes (not to the walk).

include_edges.description:
Return the edges between the returned nodes (and the start node).
Default `true`.

include_start.description: Return the start node too (depth 0). Default `false`.

edges.description: Edges between the returned nodes (and the start node).

nodes.description: Reached nodes, nearest first, then by id.

truncated.description: More nodes or edges matched than were returned.

TraversedNode.description: A node reached by a traversal.

depth.description: Fewest hops from the start node.

ttl_ms.description: Milliseconds from now until the key expires (positive).

UpsertItem.description: One item to insert or replace.

id.description:
1 to 64 of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`; generated when absent. An existing item
with this id is replaced completely.

metadata.description: JSON object, filterable with the filter language (`category = 'news'`).

text.description: Text for keyword search (the full-text side of hybrid search).

vectors.description: Vector per field name. Fields left out have no vector for this item.

items.description: 1 to 1000 items, written in one transaction.

created.description: Items that did not exist before.

updated.description: Last change of the definition or the data.

VectorField.description: A vector field of a collection.

expansion_add.description: HNSW candidate list size while inserting.

expansion_search.description: HNSW candidate list size while searching.

quantization.description: Element type of the ANN index.

Worker.description: A worker that registered or claimed jobs.

api_key.name: X-API-Key
api_key.description: Service-account API key or personal access token (alternative to the bearer header).

bearer.bearerFormat: access token (HS256 JWT), API key (fbk_…) or personal access token (fbp_…)
bearer.description: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Access tokens come from `/api/auth/login` and `/api/auth/refresh`; API keys and PATs carry scopes (`<area>:read|write[:<name>]`).

session_cookie.name: fb_session
session_cookie.description: Browser session cookie from `/api/auth/login` with `cookie: true`; unsafe methods also need `X-CSRF-Token`.
